text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(A few days have passed since we posted
our first video
to the academy's official sub-channel. The
response exceeded all expectations—)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Look, comments are saying '100 million
goal is lol', 'I'm rooting for you!', and
'Retweet! Share!'
Wow, what a massive response! As expected
of Love-chan, all according to plan?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Everyone was much more
welcoming than I expected.
Really, the fans' energy is such a
blessing!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We already have so many people subscribing
to the channel!
Now all we need to do is keep posting
videos together—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I see. So Loves-chan had a hand in this.
I thought somethin' interestin' was goin'
on."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Lala-san! Perfect timing♪ If you'd like,
would you want to film a video with me?
We're just about to get ready.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Me too? ...Are ya sure? That makes me so
happy, I'd love to join in.
By the way, what're we gonna be doin'?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A video that official channels wouldn't
make, but fans would love...
That was the concept I built this around.
To put it simply—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ch-Ch-Ch... Charm point
introoooduction~~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, first... allow me to introduce
Lala-san's charming qualities.
That would be... of course...—her
honor-student-like versatility and
adaptability.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Flexible with her positioning, capable of
aiming for victory from anywhere...
A truly versatile runner unbothered by
track conditions... Even in her last race,
from the very start—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"............ Thanks. You really watch me
closely, Chrono-chan.
While you're at it, could you tell me some
easy-to-spot stuff too? Like my looks or
somethin'."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah! M-My apologies. Another wonderful
point about Lala-san is...
Her eyes, I suppose... They shine
brilliantly, even during races.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank you kindly. I'm glad to hear
it.
Especially since someone close to me has
quite distinctive eyes...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Speakin' of which... I really love
Chrono-chan's eyes too.
They're so round and adorable... Fufu,
don't be shy. Can I take a photo?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And when the talk turns to racing, your
eyes blaze... Ah, yes, that look.
Having that turned on me mid-race is
simply irresistible... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
In Loves's eyes, Gran-chan's "love" point
is... the red on her ears!
You dyed it, right? Inner ear color is so
stylish and gorgeous♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's my signature red! Also, I want
you to capture this part too...
Look, the hair parting is an 'M'! ...As in
Mile~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, switched over! Love-chan's "mile"
point is...~
Her hair! It's shaped like a heart, right?
So cute! Did you curl it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You'd think so, right? But nope~... it's
just my natural bedhead!
Fufu, surprising, isn't it? Seems I'm
destined to be wrapped in love♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"......Oh? Fufu, you're taking this
seriously, aren't you?
In that case! Look, over here too... and
the side! Love~♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh... That looks so fun~ Super bubbly
and cute!
I want people to praise my cute side too♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! That definitely fits better.
Decided! I'll look for someone who'll
praise me, and show 'em the video—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case!
Then you ought to become a princesssss!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That scared the crap outta meeeeeee!
W-W-What was that!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Once you become a princess, you'll be
showered with insane praise!
Come on, let's film our lesson video
together♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice! The genius magical girl, Sweepy,
is going to give you
special princess lessons! First
up—wardrobe magic☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
SOOO CUUUTE!! Wait, isn't this insane?
Isn't it like, totally princess-vibes?
Princes are gonna come swarming, fr♡ We
are the most princessy in the universe♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! What are princess
lessons like?
Do you practice dancing for parties and
stuff?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu, that is far too soft! What a
princess must seek is...
naught but Beautiful Power! Let the
photoshoot commence!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
――...Gasp!?
H-Huh!? Where's the castle... the dress...
my designer bags...!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Utterly preposterous!
What begins now is... the succession of
the Princess Retsusun, Hundredth Dan!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Castles and bags alike are things you
seize with your own two hands!
A princess is pure, righteous,
beautiful—and undeniably strong!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll support you with magic! First up...
you need the leg power
to sprint up the castle stairs! It's
Princess Squat time!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
W-W-W-What?!
Whaaaaaaaaaaaat?!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, drop those hips already! You want
praise, don't you?!
Give me 500 first, and if you clear that,
I'll praise you! Then 1,000 next!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Peace♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Something just swept past!! Gah, I
should've seen that punchline coming!
Ugh, aww, man... Help meee! Mommy,
Daddy~~~~!!

Princess, seize your future! Tomorrow is
now!
